ripgrep 14.1.1

Usage: rg [OPTIONS] PATTERN [PATH ...]
  rg [OPTIONS] -e PATTERN [PATH ...]
  rg [OPTIONS] [-f PATTERNFILE] [PATH ...]

Search for PATTERN in files in PATH (or the current directory).

FLAGS:
  -i, --ignore-case       Case insensitive search
  -v, --invert-match      Invert matching
  -w, --word-regexp       Only show matches surrounded by word boundaries
  -n, --line-number       Show line numbers
  -l, --files-with-matches Only print paths with at least one match
  -c, --count             Show count of matching lines per file
  -r, --replace REPLACEMENT Replace matches with the given text
  -U, --multiline         Search across lines
  -z, --search-zip        Search compressed files

OPTIONS:
  -t, --type TYPE         Only search files matching TYPE
  -g, --glob GLOB         Include or exclude files matching GLOB
  -m, --max-count NUM     Limit the number of matching lines per file
      --max-depth NUM     Limit descent to NUM directories
  -j, --threads NUM       Number of search threads

Other options:
  -h, --help              Print help
  -V, --version           Print version
